additions.reason: The text says: 'כח זה בחינת כ"ח אתוון דמעשה בראשית, בחינת עשרה מאמרות שבהם נברא העולם'. The 28 letters of creation are identified as the substance/content of what those dwelling in the Heichal HaMelech illuminate through כבוד. The term 'בחינת' is used, equating the כח (strength) of those in the Heichal with these 28 letters. This is a neutral/good concept — the structural objects of creation's speech. It belongs in Package 1 as it is the content of מוחין/נועם that is revealed through כבוד. However, it could stand as a neutral structural concept. Either way, it is missing from the dataset.
additions.source_quote: כֹּחַ זֶה בְּחִינַת כ"ח אַתְוָן דְּמַעֲשֵׂה בְרֵאשִׁית, בְּחִינַת עֲשָׂרָה מַאֲמָרוֹת שֶׁבָּהֶם נִבְרָא הָעוֹלָם

additions.reason: The final synthesis of the Torah says: 'וזה בחינת השירה, בחינת נעים זמירות ישראל'. Song/שירה is declared a bechina of the entire teaching — of נועם, of the כבוד revealed through the vessel of צדקה, of the pleasant dimension of Torah. The text closes with this as the synthesis but without elaboration ('ולא גילה יותר'). שירה belongs in Package 1 as the final, all-encompassing expression of נועם.
additions.source_quote: וְזֶה בְּחִינַת הַשִּׁירָה, בְּחִינַת נְעִים זְמִרוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל

additions.reason: The text describes those 'שהם בהיכלא דמלכא' as the ones who ascend all honor to God and understand from which divine utterance each honor originated. Being in the Heichal HaMelech is equated with having strength (כח = כ"ח אתוון) and is explicitly called a bechina via the verse 'ובהיכלו כולו אומר כבוד'. The Heichal is the domain where כבוד is recognized as entirely an אמירה/מאמר. This concept is a good domain that relates to the revelation of כבוד, belonging in Package 1 (as it is the context of נועם/מוחין). However it could be argued to stand between packages. It is clearly missing from the bechina dataset.
